preconditions.description: The length of numbers a and b must be between 2 and 100,000.
Both numbers a and b must be n-digit numbers within the specified range.
Numbers a and b must have the same number of digits.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to win the jackpot, the output must be -1.
The minimal number of coins c must be a non-negative integer not exceeding 100,000.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= d_i <= n - 1 and s_i in [-1, 1] for d_i, s_i in moves)
postconditions.description: Each move must specify valid indices and operations within the allowed range.
